name: Ada
source: The boss at the lab. Enjoys wearing skin-tight clothing, or going naked with holographic censor bars projected in front of her. Often challenges people to perverted dares when she's drunk, in the form of "do [thing] or you're fired!", regardless of whether the other person actually works for her.
